description: This software implements a predictive modeling pipeline for regional GDP using Wastewater-Based Epidemiology (WBE) data. It ingests open-source datasets from the European Union Drugs Agency (EUDA) and Eurostat, performs data cleaning and city-to-NUTS-3 region mapping, and merges them into a longitudinal dataset. Three regression models are trained and evaluated: a Random Forest Regression, a Simple Linear Regression, and a Nested Linear Mixed Model (LMM). The pipeline produces performance metrics (RMSE, MAE, R²), prediction plots, and comparison tables to assess the relationship between illicit drug metabolite concentrations in municipal wastewater and regional economic output.
name: Predictive Modeling of Regional GDP based on Wastewater-Based Epidemiology
